How this list is compiled

Listed companies produce battery cells of any chemistry, at commercial scale or on pilot and development lines. Makers of primary (non-rechargeable) cells are labeled.

Not listed: pack and module assemblers that buy cells, materials and equipment suppliers, and companies that only research or license cell technology.

This list is curated, not exhaustive: a company is listed only when we can confirm it fits these criteria.

Missing a company? Submit it to the directory. Spotted a mistake? Open the company's profile and suggest an edit there.
